description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HealthController that provides a health check endpoint at /healthz. The endpoint responds with a JSON indicating the application's health status, used for load balancers and uptime monitoring.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A simple REST controller providing a health check endpoint at /healthz, which returns a JSON response indicating status 'ok'.

methods.name: getHealth
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /healthz, returning a JSON map with 'status':'ok' indicating the application is healthy.
